mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia); azithromycin may also prolong QT interval while amphotericin B carries inherent cardiotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and ECG closely; use amphotericin B lipid formulations when possible to reduce nephrotoxicity; consider alternative macrolide if available.
